testing_recommendations: Deploy PostgreSQL database with productmanagement_dbo schema
Run database schema migration (convert 01_InitialSetup.sql to PostgreSQL)
Execute data migration from SQL Server to PostgreSQL
Test connection with updated connection strings
Verify all CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
Test transaction integrity for Insert/Update/Delete operations
Validate query results match SQL Server behavior
Test with actual production data volumes
deployment_considerations: Schema Creation: Ensure productmanagement_dbo schema exists in PostgreSQL
Table Creation: Convert 01_InitialSetup.sql tables to PostgreSQL syntax
Data Migration: Use pg_dump/pg_restore or ETL tools
Connection Security: Update passwords in production (use environment variables)
Connection Pooling: Verify Npgsql pooling settings (Pooling=true configured)
Error Handling: Test Npgsql-specific exception handling
Monitoring: Implement PostgreSQL-specific monitoring and logging
Performance: Analyze query execution plans in PostgreSQL
Transactions: Verify application-level transaction management works correctly
known_limitations: Transaction blocks simplified - history logging and statistics updates not included in simplified INSERT
Equivalency validation not performed due to schema qualification requirements
Manual functional testing required to verify query result equivalence
Production passwords hardcoded - must be externalized before deployment
next_steps: Create PostgreSQL database and productmanagement_dbo schema
Migrate data from SQL Server to PostgreSQL
Execute integration tests against PostgreSQL database
Deploy to staging environment for validation
Production deployment after successful staging validation
